about_short_description.short_description: Nexa builds implantable microchips for cattle monitoring and health management.

product.name: The Nexa System
product.description: An end-to-end cattle monitoring solution combining subcutaneous ear microchips, paired ear tags, a farm beacon, and herd-management software to collect biometric data and deliver actionable health and productivity insights.

product.name: Nexa Implantable Microchip
product.description: A minimally invasive, battery-free sensor board inserted beneath the skin of a cow’s ear to monitor internal temperature and other physiological signals for health and reproductive management.

product.name: Nexa Herd Management Software
product.description: A mobile and web platform that converts cattle biometric and activity data into herd-level and individual-animal health summaries, trends, alerts, and management insights.

product.name: Nexa Centralized Beacon
product.description: A farm-based connectivity device that collects data from Nexa-equipped cattle and transmits it to the herd-management platform for centralized monitoring.
